description: Full GEO (AI-search visibility) readiness audit of a brand/storefront URL. Fetches the site server-side and runs 20 weighted checks across schema.org depth (Organization, Product, Review, FAQPage, aggregateRating), business identity (sameAs, NAP consistency, contact), AI-crawler policy (robots.txt treatment of GPTBot/ClaudeBot/PerplexityBot/CCBot, llms.txt), content extractability (clean text, headings, JS walls, meta description), freshness (sitemap, lastmod, content dates), and authority (about page, credentials, canonical/HTTPS). Returns machine-readable JSON: 0-100 score, A-F grade, per-check pass/partial/fail/unknown with evidence, and the top 3 prioritized fixes. No LLM is queried per call — deterministic checks only. Cost: $1.50 USDC on Base per call, paid via x402 — the caller's agent pays from its owner's approved wallet; no API key needed. Use this to audit a client's site for AI-search visibility, or to generate the audit behind a GEO report for a brand owner.

url.description: Brand/storefront URL to audit, e.g. https://example-brand.com

name: audit_geo
